title: Carbon dots and DNA: DNA binding mechanisms and their effect on the cell cycle arrest.
authors: Chen, Jiuyan; Li, Fang; Yang, Jiawen; Gu, Jun; Ellerbe, Kayla; Zhao, Bowen; Shiri, Mehrdad; Zhou, Yiqun; Ajith, Arya; Joji, Annu; Zhang, Wei; Abayawardena, Deema; Wikramanayake, Athula H; Wang, Kun; Zhang, Fuwu; Verde, Fulvia; Prabhakar, Rajeev; Zhang, Yanbin; Leblanc, Roger M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究碳点与DNA的结合机制（插层和沟槽结合）及其对细胞周期阻滞的影响，采用分子对接和MD模拟，虽非TF-DNA体系，但蛋白-DNA互作建模方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Carbon dots (CDs), a type of carbon-based nanoparticles with sizes less than 10 nm, have been widely employed in nucleus-targeted drug delivery for cancer therapy and imaging, and some are capable of binding to DNA after entering the nucleus. OBJECTIVES: Our study was designed to investigate the DNA binding mechanisms of CDs and their effect on the cell cycle arrest in cancer cells. METHODS: Two types of CDs, Y15-CDs and Black-CDs (B-CDs) with similar sizes but carry positive and negative charges, respectively, were selected for investigation. The successful synthesis of CDs was confirmed by UV-vis, fluorescence emission and Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopies, transmission electron microscope (TEM), atomic force microscope (AFM) and zeta potential measurement. DNA binding mechanisms of CDs were investigated using fluorometric competitive displacement assays, circular dichroism spectroscopy, molecular docking, all-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and binding free energy calculations. The in vitro studies including intracellular distribution, cytotoxicity, DNA damage detection and cell cycle distribution were evaluated in osteosarcoma (U2OS) cells. Zebrafish embryos were used as an in vivo mode to assess the influence of CDs on embryonic development. RESULTS: DNA binding results show that Y15-CDs bind to DNA via both intercalative and groove binding modes, while B-CDs engage only in groove binding. In addition, Y15-CDs possess a stronger affinity to DNA. According to in vitro studies, Y15-CDs could induce DNA damage, arrest U2OS cells in S phase, and exhibit higher cytotoxicity than B-CDs. The in vivo experiments demonstrate that after distributing throughout the zebrafish embryonic body, Y15-CDs reduce body length, eye size and head size of embryos. CONCLUSION: Our results elucidate the DNA binding mechanisms of CDs and their potential influence on the cell cycle profile of cancer cells, offering valuable insights into the design of CDs with both drug delivery and intrinsic anticancer properties.
abstract_zh: 引言：碳点（Carbon dots, CDs）是一类尺寸小于10纳米的碳基纳米颗粒，已广泛用于癌症治疗和成像的核靶向药物递送，其中一些在进入细胞核后能够与DNA结合。目的：本研究旨在探讨CDs的DNA结合机制及其对癌细胞细胞周期阻滞的影响。方法：选取两种尺寸相似但分别携带正电荷和负电荷的CDs，即Y15-CDs和黑碳点（Black-CDs, B-CDs），进行研究。通过紫外-可见光谱、荧光发射光谱、傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）、原子力显微镜（AFM）和zeta电位测量确认了CDs的成功合成。利用荧光竞争性置换实验、圆二色光谱、分子对接、全原子分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟和结合自由能计算研究了CDs的DNA结合机制。在骨肉瘤（U2OS）细胞中评估了体外研究，包括细胞内分布、细胞毒性、DNA损伤检测和细胞周期分布。斑马鱼胚胎作为体内模型用于评估CDs对胚胎发育的影响。结果：DNA结合结果表明，Y15-CDs通过嵌入和沟槽结合两种模式与DNA结合，而B-CDs仅参与沟槽结合。此外，Y15-CDs对DNA具有更强的亲和力。根据体外研究，Y15-CDs能诱导DNA损伤，使U2OS细胞阻滞在S期，并表现出比B-CDs更高的细胞毒性。体内实验表明，Y15-CDs在分布到斑马鱼胚胎全身后，会减小胚胎的体长、眼径和头部尺寸。结论：我们的结果阐明了CDs的DNA结合机制及其对癌细胞细胞周期谱的潜在影响，为设计兼具药物递送和内在抗癌特性的CDs提供了宝贵见解。
